exposure: Ritonavir-boosted protease inhibitor (PI) regimen for HIV-1
Integrase strand transfer inhibitor (ISTI) regimen for HIV-1
Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) regimen for HIV-1
cohort: The study included 794 pregnancies reported between 2008 and 2018 from a national observational study, involving pregnant women with HIV-1 whose pregnancies ended in live births and who were exposed to three-drug antiretroviral regimens (PI, NNRTI, or ISTI) within 32 weeks of gestation.
finding: After adjusting for confounders, there were no major differences in a wide range of pregnancy and neonatal outcomes among pregnant women with HIV-1 exposed to PI, NNRTI, or ISTI regimens.
